item.title: Apple Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Growth Amid Insider Stock Sales
item.description:
Apple Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Growth Amid Insider Stock Sales

Apple has reported financial results for Q3 2026 showing revenue growth alongside significant stock divestments by company insiders and varied trading activity from members of Congress.

⚙️ Key details

  • Financial Performance: Apple reported Q3 2026 revenues of $109.4B, representing a 16.36% increase from the same period in the prior year.
  • Market Sentiment: Views reflect measured optimism tied to product timelines and chart patterns, with traders discussing consolidation phases.
  • Product Outlook: Discussions center on manufacturing updates for next-generation iPhone models, their impact on supply chains, and potential gains from new device features.

📉 Insider Transactions

In the past 6 months, Apple insiders have traded $AAPL stock 15 times, with 0 purchases and 15 sales.

🏛️ Congressional Trading

Members of Congress have traded $AAPL stock 21 times in the past 6 months, consisting of 8 purchases and 13 sales.

  • Representative John McGuire: Conducted 2 trades, including 1 purchase worth up to $15,000 on 04/15 and 1 sale worth up to $15,000 on 08/18.
  • Representative Cleo Fields: Conducted 2 trades, including 2 purchases worth up to $30,000 on 08/13 and 05/14, and 0 sales.
